title: ever NOIRE|Glitter V-Neck Cruise Journey Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning evening dress is perfect for cruise journeys and special occasions. Featuring a flattering V-neckline, shimmering glitter details, and an elegant silhouette, it ensures you stand out at any event. Comfortable yet glamorous, it's ideal for making unforgettable memories on your cruise adventure.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, no lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.

Occasion: Formal, Military Ball, Evening, Gala, Party,Cruise Journey
